headline: Wilmington and Felician yet to lose in conference play
dek: Wilmington and Felician have both come through conference play so far without a defeat. Wilmington's three losses all came before it opened, and they have not lost since; their season now stands at seven wins and five draws, with 24 goals scored and 20 conceded.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Dominican have scored nine goals and conceded 23. The foot of the chart is still a side with two wins, four draws and eight defeats, whose trouble is at both ends of the pitch rather than one.

wire.line: Jefferson's win over Bridgeport leaves Wilmington level with them on points at the top of the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored eight goals for Georgian Court and assisted eight more, from 60 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mathias Kristoffersen has kept six shutouts for Felician and conceded ten goals in all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson's win over Bridgeport was their fifth of the season, beside two draws and seven defeats; they have scored 22 goals and conceded 23.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 47 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, in a season of one win, three draws and eleven defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eliass Elfasoukhi has scored seven of Post's goals from 33 shots, with three assists beside them.

last_match.line: Bridgeport have now lost twice in conference play; Jefferson answered their defeat at Post two days earlier.

next_match.line: Felician have yet to lose in conference play; Bridgeport come in off their defeat at Jefferson.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
